name: arkive-viewer
//: react/react-dom are intentionally NOT installed here. The viewer is nested in src/viewer/, so installing its own copy produced a second React in the module graph, which breaks hooks at runtime. src/viewer/vite.config.ts already aliases every react import to the root node_modules copy; omitting them here makes Node's normal upward resolution do the same thing for tests and for `tsc`. See architecture decision dec-003.
